description: This file contains implementation code for configuring network settings in the Cuttlefish project, including classes and functions to parse network interface attributes and set network parameters such as IP address, gateway, DNS, and broadcast address.

classes.name: NetConfig
classes.description: A class responsible for obtaining and parsing network interface attributes such as IP address, gateway, broadcast address, and prefix length.

methods.name: number_of_ones
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits (ones) in an unsigned long value.

methods.name: ObtainConfig
methods.description: Attempts to obtain network configuration for a specified interface and DNS.

methods.name: ParseInterfaceAttributes
methods.description: Parses network interface attributes from a given ifaddrs structure.

methods.name: ParseInterfaceAttributes
methods.description: Iterates over network interfaces to find and parse attributes for a specified interface name.

methods.name: ConfigureNetworkSettings
methods.description: Main function to configure network settings based on interface data and update the instance configuration.
